bulwarkRumor0.text: Jotunns are the most powerful creatures of the Bulwarks.

bulwarkRumor1.text: I've heard that the residents of the Bulwark will invoke the Forebear Spirits to honor the one who brings them the Grail.

bulwarkRumor2.text: The Kobolds are matchless miners. No one can find gold quite like them.

bulwarkRumor3.text: Avoid the Argali at all costs. It is known that all kinds of magic become more dangerous when cast around them.

bulwarkRumor4.text: The Snow Elves are unparalleled spear throwers.

bulwarkRumor5.text: Many people only know the Yeti to be monsters, ferocious in battle, but there are Elders and Chieftains among them who wield the power of the Runes.

bulwarkRumor6.text: Magic of the Shamans can protect their allies from missiles, and also turn their enemies into ice.

bulwarkRumor7.text: Few creatures can match the Mammoths in resilience.

bulwarkRumor8.text: It is said that the Jotunns are masters of teleportation magic.

bulwarkRumor9.text: It is known that the Bulwarks are the only place where one can master the knowledge of the Runes.

bulwarkRumor10.text: It is said that the people of the Bulwarks are particularly fond of holding fairs.

bulwarkRumor11.text: Rumor has it that the island of Vori is the womb whence all Elves came.
